LightningComponentBundle.description: Standalone mass import component. Select an Import Settings template to render the corresponding import UI with file upload, field mapping, and batch processing.

property.name: templateName
property.label: Import Settings Template
property.description: Select the Import Settings template defined in Import Settings Manager.

property.name: reminderMessage
property.label: Reminder Message
property.description: Optional reminder/instructions displayed above the file upload area. Supports a plain text value or a Salesforce Custom Label name.

property.name: recordId
property.label: Record Id
property.description: Id of the current record. Bind this to a record variable in Experience Builder to enable record-page context. Should be set to {!recordId}
